# Degardis Authoring

**Version:** `1.0.0` · **License:** [MIT](../../LICENSE)

## Purpose

Guide an agent in authoring, reviewing, or revising AI agent skills in the
Degardis source format, then use Degardis to validate them and compile them
into installable AI agent skill bundles.

## When it applies

This skill applies when an agent needs to create or change an AI agent skill in
the Degardis source format, assess existing sources, select profiles, validate
a collection, compile an installable AI agent skill folder or ZIP archive, or
install generated output.

> **Note:** Degardis Authoring is not a general-purpose skill-authoring skill;
> its scope is AI agent skills in the Degardis source format. The agent authors
> the source content; Degardis validates it and compiles an installable AI
> agent skill bundle.

## Capabilities

- Guides the agent in designing independently usable skills with a clear routing boundary.
- Guides source work across manifests, workflows, entries, profiles, scripts, and assets.
- Uses Degardis to validate individual skills and recursively discovered collections.
- Uses Degardis to build folder or ZIP artifacts for inspection.
- Prepares generated skills for filesystem agents or ChatGPT.

## Sample prompts

- "Draft an AI agent skill in the Degardis source format for reviewing database schemas."
- "Review and improve this Degardis skill."
- "Add a framework-specific profile to this skill."
- "Validate and build this skill for installation."
- "Package this skill as a ZIP for ChatGPT."

## Install for your agent

> [!WARNING]
> Before installing any third-party AI agent skill, review its instructions
> and executable scripts, and confirm that you trust its source.

Download the latest packaged [Degardis Authoring skill][packaged-skill] in ZIP format,
then follow the repository's [installation guide][installation-guide]. The
guide covers filesystem-based agents, safe upgrades, and ChatGPT uploads.
